findings.evidence: Roadmap `Suggested.lean:91-95` states the L4 consumer with local hypotheses on `Ω`; `rg` in this file finds only `ContinuousOn (schwarzReflection f)` on arbitrary upper subsets (`line 248`) and lower open parts (`line 269`), plus the global `Continuous` theorem at `line 283`, but no `Ω`-local gluing theorem.
findings.fix: Add a localized theorem, e.g. `ContinuousOn (schwarzReflection f) Ω` under `IsOpen Ω`, conjugation symmetry, `ContinuousOn f (Ω ∩ {z | 0 ≤ z.im})`, and `∀ z ∈ Ω, z.im = 0 → (f z).im = 0`; the global theorem can then be a specialization.
findings.issue: `continuous_schwarzReflection` requires `ContinuousOn f {z | 0 ≤ z.im}` and `hreal` on the whole real axis, but the roadmap target is local on a conjugation-symmetric open `Ω` with only `ContinuousOn f (Ω ∩ {z | 0 ≤ z.im})` and real values on `Ω`; the API does not characterize continuity of `schwarzReflection f` on such an `Ω`.

summary: The continuity surface is missing the local gluing theorem needed by the stated L4 roadmap consumer; the exported API only gives global plane continuity or continuity on the two separate branches.
